dict.string: kst reads only the active iTerm pane identity and shell-prompt status after you request terminal dictation. It never sends terminal commands through Automation.
kst listens only after Start listening, Arm wake phrase or an explicit dictation shortcut/action, using on-device recognition for requests and typing into supported focused fields.
kst uses on-device Apple speech recognition for spoken requests and explicit dictation into supported focused fields. Online recognition is disabled.
